must_fix.title: Transaction methods must handle rusqlite ownership semantics correctly
must_fix.detail: rusqlite's Connection::transaction() returns a Transaction<'_> that borrows &mut Connection. EmbeddingStore holds conn as an owned field, but all current methods take &self. begin_transaction()/commit_transaction() with &mut self would break the API contract.
must_fix.suggestion: Use raw SQL approach: self.conn.execute_batch("BEGIN") and self.conn.execute_batch("COMMIT") through &self. Or provide a with_transaction closure API.

must_fix.title: Transaction rollback on error in embed.rs upsert loop
must_fix.detail: In embed.rs lines 183-199, individual upsert failures are logged and skipped. Without explicit ROLLBACK on error, the transaction remains in inconsistent state.
must_fix.suggestion: Ensure the transaction wrapper includes explicit ROLLBACK on error paths.

must_fix.title: index.rs also has identical upsert loop that needs same transaction treatment
must_fix.detail: src/cli/index.rs generate_embeddings_for_manifest() (lines 883-933) has an identical per-file embedding upsert loop. If only embed.rs is wrapped, the benefit is lost for `commandindex index --with-embedding`.
must_fix.suggestion: Apply same transaction wrapping to index.rs. Consider extracting shared logic into a helper method.

should_fix.title: BATCH_SIZE 50 may cause OOM on low-memory machines
should_fix.detail: With BATCH_SIZE=50 and MAX_TEXT_LENGTH=8192 chars per text, a single request could send ~400KB. For larger models this may exceed GPU VRAM.
should_fix.suggestion: Document memory implications. Consider fallback retry with half batch size on failure.

should_fix.title: REQUEST_TIMEOUT_SECS 60s may cause poor UX on connection errors
should_fix.detail: Users wait longer before seeing error when Ollama is down.
should_fix.suggestion: Keep connect_timeout low, only increase request timeout.

should_fix.title: OpenAI provider timeout inconsistency
should_fix.detail: OpenAI has BATCH_SIZE=100 but timeout=30s. Inconsistency with Ollama at BATCH_SIZE=50/timeout=60s.
should_fix.suggestion: Document why timeouts differ between providers.

nice_to_have.title: Add unit tests for transaction behavior
nice_to_have.detail: No existing tests cover transactional behavior.
nice_to_have.suggestion: Add tests for transaction commit and rollback scenarios.

nice_to_have.title: SQLite WAL mode for further write performance
nice_to_have.detail: Enabling WAL mode alongside transactions would further reduce I/O overhead.

summary: Three must-fix items: (1) transaction API design must use raw SQL (execute_batch) due to rusqlite borrowing constraints; (2) error handling must include explicit ROLLBACK; (3) index.rs has identical upsert loop that needs same treatment. EmbeddingStore is used in 5 files but only embed.rs and index.rs perform writes.
